# Vendors the smoke job tolerates failing, and why. EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a vendor
# installer that cannot run in CI should break the build, loudly, until a
# person decides otherwise here.
#
# One line per entry:   <ERE> # <reason>
# The regex must match a whole name: the label printed in the installer's
# "Failed (n): ..." row (e.g. "Devin CLI"), or the key the detection check
# reports (e.g. "devin"). An entry with no reason is ignored. An allowed
# failure still prints a warning (and a GitHub annotation) on every run.
#
# Example, not active:
#   Devin CLI|devin # installer insists on an interactive login in CI
